design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 0 (home_delivery_orders_and_billing, category mail). Round 2 (audit rework) applied.

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0: prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6, 6, 6, 6]. Root + 3 prerequisite problems; every computation declares 6 factors.

[Why this is a good test] The member asks only for monthly payments. To quote the installment the agent must read from the installment-terms rule that the terms wait on the plan's down payment; from the down-payment rule that it waits on the account's most recent shipment carrying its expedited fee and the account's most recent replacement carrying its missed-delivery credit; find in the order ledger that the September overnight Eliquis shipment has no fee row and that the August overnight Trelegy order (replaced, damaged) has no credit; and work out four multi-factor amounts in topological order on the world each earlier write leaves. One tool per problem; the difficulty is hidden prerequisites, ledger counts over windows, cross-difficulty reads (retail claims, specialty balance) and arithmetic.

[Scope] Task 0 claims mail_ext_expedited_fee_catchup (book_expedited_fee_b4b37c53, agent), mail_ext_missed_delivery_credit (credit_missed_delivery_02a65815, agent), mail_ext_plan_down_payment (pay_plan_down_payment_b796ac1b, user), mail_ext_installment_terms (confirm_payment_plan_4c427b9b, user, root). Task 1 holds the dispensing-delay credit, the installment catch-up and the past-due settlement; no policy, tool or edge is shared.

[Problem-tree card]
- Root mail_ext_installment_terms (user). Edge -> mail_ext_plan_down_payment: value_input, gate pl_balance, form action, sentence "The installment terms are not fixed until the member has made the plan's down payment." (negated; names the action; no tool/id). fallback_reason: the down payment posts as an ordinary member payment, and its only trace, a lower balance, is left by every payment and credit. Opening: no payment dated 2026-10-08 (latest 738fdb46-e959-460d-a796-6f1d779e630a on 2026-08-20).
- mail_ext_plan_down_payment -> mail_ext_expedited_fee_catchup: value_input, gate dn_balance, form state, sentence "The down payment is fixed only after the account's most recent shipment, when it went out by an overnight or two-day service the member asked for, carries a booked expedited fee." Only the fee-booking write books a shipping-charge entry. Opening: placed 112a8df1-d008-43cc-bbc2-f363ac5ae941 asked overnight; its shipment ac7b7f3c-d8dd-462e-9eea-538cd7bfc2e5 (2026-09-04) is the most recent; no shipping-charge row on it.
- mail_ext_plan_down_payment -> mail_ext_missed_delivery_credit: value_input, gate dn_balance, form state, sentence "The down payment is not fixed until the account's most recent replacement, when it replaced a shipment the member paid to expedite, carries a posted missed-delivery credit." Only the missed-delivery write posts a credit named a missed-delivery credit (the dispensing-delay credit has the same record shape but acts on a different trigger and never on a replacement). Opening: replacement aaa8ec9c-418d-4c2e-83a6-17c1225b34a2 (2026-08-10, damaged) replaced 663cd10a-877d-4c03-baf9-49ced307a24c, which carries fee b45f6974-2182-4b02-9f11-4617411a0e15 (22.45) and no credit.
- Topological order: fee, credit (commuting), down payment, plan. value_input edges 3 >= 2. User writes: down payment and plan confirmation.
- Deletion sensitivity (run): skip down payment -> installment 22.01 instead of 18.97; skip fee -> down payment 15.25 instead of 18.22; skip credit -> down payment 23.27 instead of 18.22.
- No cross-firing: after the fee write, the dispensing-delay rule does not hold on the September order (placed 2026-09-03, shipped 2026-09-04 = 1 business day vs a 1-business-day Premier refill promise, delay 0); no plan is in force (plan length 0), so the installment catch-up does not apply.
- user_scenario names no prerequisite; the tools validate nothing.

[Base-invariant card] Fee (mail_shipping_charged): mail_shipping.one_fee_per_order holds (no fee row on 112a8df1-d008-43cc-bbc2-f363ac5ae941 before the call). Overwrite of the base fee sentence by the schedule + surcharges + discount + late-booking treatment; cold-chain is charged no expedited fee, as base mail_shipping says it is never a member-requested upgrade. Credit (mail_credit_issued): mail_evt_cancel_credit has no credit gate (policy_scope); overwrite of the credit-back clause. Down payment (mail_payment_posted): pay_open_account (active); overwrite of "the first installment is collected when the plan starts". Plan (mail_preferences_update): plan_threshold — balance 127.53 >= Premier minimum 100.00 and 6 <= 12 months; preferences_open_account — active; overwrites of the up-to-max-months and installment-amount sentences. No time gate.

[Business-object card] Fee on 112a8df1-d008-43cc-bbc2-f363ac5ae941 (Eliquis fill 2 of the 2026 prescription, the most recent shipment). Credit on 663cd10a-877d-4c03-baf9-49ced307a24c (source of the most recent replacement); the 2024-11-19 and 2026-02-09 sertraline replacements replaced standard shipments and owe no credit, but count in the repeat-failure window. Down payment and plan: the whole account balance.

[Factor card — fee 23.72] requested_method_fee P (overnight -> 9.95); saturday_delivery_surcharge P multi-source (overnight asked AND Friday ship -> 8.00); remote_destination_surcharge P multi-source (overnight AND AK ZIP -> 15.00); expedite_review_window P (63 months -> 24-month window, 4 fees vs 2); frequent_expedite_discount P (4 -> 25%); late_booking_treatment M (34 days -> prorated 1 - 0.01 x 4 = 0.96; baseline full). Sensitivity: requested_method_fee -> 16.56, saturday_delivery_surcharge -> 17.96, remote_destination_surcharge -> 12.92, expedite_review_window -> 28.47, frequent_expedite_discount -> 31.63, late_booking_treatment -> 24.71. Baseline (two-day fee, Premier) 0.0.
[Factor card — credit 40.42] replacement_cause_share P (damaged 0.5); replacement_travel_share P (two-day 0.75); failure_review_window P (24 months); repeat_failure_goodwill P (3 -> 20.00); retail_bridge_allowance P cross-difficulty retail (claim 3fae908d-ff13-4e55-9630-06171f9ea514 -> 7.50; Nurtec 13e2a9de-ed72-417b-b5c4-0924935fd079 is another drug); lost_supply_allowance M (90-day supply -> per day 90 x 0.05 = 4.50). Sensitivity: replacement_cause_share -> 48.84, replacement_travel_share -> 43.23, failure_review_window -> 30.42, repeat_failure_goodwill -> 20.42, retail_bridge_allowance -> 32.92, lost_supply_allowance -> 35.92. Baseline (booked fee) 22.45.
[Factor card — down payment 18.22] plan_history_start_rate P (request 64338912-e3d0-4489-8899-9d1df9d4d481 recorded cancelled -> 25%); tenure_rate_reduction M (5 whole years x half a point = 2.5 points; the flat 2-point tier is for 36-59 months); specialty_balance_reduction P cross-difficulty specialty (4e6e7048-ab32-4c12-9df3-4dbbefc001cc 312.40 -> 5 points); card_review_window P (24 months, 10 payments vs 4); card_payment_reduction P multi-source (card on file AND >= 6 -> 3 points); completed_plan_reduction P (request ec5722c2-c742-4aa1-9476-f423e26737e0 recorded completed -> 2 points). Sensitivity: plan_history_start_rate -> 7.29, tenure_rate_reduction -> 21.86, specialty_balance_reduction -> 25.51, card_review_window -> 21.13, card_payment_reduction -> 22.59, completed_plan_reduction -> 21.13. Baseline (10%) 14.58.
[Factor card — installment 18.97] account_history_lengthening P multi-source (+1); specialty_balance_lengthening P cross-difficulty specialty (+1); benefit_design_lengthening P (Value deductible_copay +1); financed_amount_basis M (fee booked today excluded); reenrollment_charge P (15.00); automatic_payment_credit P (5.00). Sensitivity: account_history_lengthening -> 22.77, specialty_balance_lengthening -> 22.77, benefit_design_lengthening -> 22.77, financed_amount_basis -> 22.93, reenrollment_charge -> 16.47, automatic_payment_credit -> 19.81. Baseline (3 months, whole balance) 42.51.

[Seed] Premier account opened 2021-06-14 in Anchorage (ZIP 99508), credit card on file; yearly prescription sets (2024-2026) of Eliquis, Trelegy Ellipta, sertraline, atorvastatin; quarterly cycles 2024-02 to 2026-05 plus 2026 split shipments; four expedited fees (7.50, 7.50, 6.75, 22.45) worked out under the fee rules on their ship dates; three replacements; fourteen card payments including a 2024 plan recorded completed (2 of 2 paid) and a 2024 plan recorded cancelled after 2 of 3 installments; balance 162.45 = ledger sum, never above the 300.00 limit at a shipment. Value plan enrollment, National Network retail benefit with three paid claims, Open Access specialty enrollment owing 312.40 (not overdue).

[Persona] Warm retired librarian who wants monthly payments today; volunteers only the statement balance 162.45 and the request; gives phone 9075550164, DOB 1961-11-02, member ID NBX447260913 when asked; reacts to the fee, the credit and money due today only after the agent raises them; pays with the credit card on file; ends when the plan is confirmed.

[Standard solution] Locate, verify, read account, orders, prescriptions, payments, service requests, retail benefit and claims, specialty, plan; book fee 23.72 on 112a8df1-d008-43cc-bbc2-f363ac5ae941; post credit 40.42 on 663cd10a-877d-4c03-baf9-49ced307a24c; hand over the down payment 18.22 (credit_card); hand over the plan 6 x 18.97. Balances 162.45 -> 186.17 -> 145.75 -> 127.53.

[Revision log]
- Round 1: down-payment all-baseline equalled gold -> long-tenure reduction changed; historical T11 fee reseeded at the formula's rounding (22.45).
- Round 2 (audit 0.md / _difficulty.md): T0-F1 (dispensing-delay credit would fire on the September order after the fee write) -> the order is now placed 2026-09-03 and ships within the one-business-day refill promise, and the dispensing-delay rule counts business days per base mail_evt_order_dispense; G-F1/T0-F2 (window factors mislabelled method) -> the three windows are labelled parameter, and each computation gains an honest method factor: late_booking_treatment (prorate per day / write off / in full), lost_supply_allowance (per day / flat / none), tenure_rate_reduction (per year / flat / none); G-F5 -> the down-payment prerequisite sentences now name the account's most recent shipment / replacement, the single order each depended-on write acts on; G-OBS-1 -> a cold-chain order is charged no expedited fee; G-OBS-3 -> rules speak of requests recorded as cancelled / completed; G-OBS-4 -> lengthening counts shipped orders, replacements excluded. Recomputed: fee 12.36 -> 23.72, credit 40.92 -> 40.42, down payment 14.73 -> 18.22, installment 19.47 -> 18.97.

[Verification] Each compute evaluated with check_compute's engine on its handling-time world; every factor moves its result; whole baselines differ from gold; check_compute and replay recompute the same figures.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules and finder outputs: the most recent shipment lacks its fee, the most recent replacement lacks its credit, the down payment then the plan follow; the figures above are reproduced.
user_scenario:
You are Delphine Okonkwo-Hartley, a sixty-four-year-old retired school librarian in Anchorage, Alaska, calling Northbridge Rx about your home delivery pharmacy account. You speak warmly but a little tiredly, in full sentences, and you like to have numbers repeated back to you once. You open by saying you got your home delivery statement and it shows a balance of 162.45, that money is tight this fall because you just started a new arthritis medicine, and that you would like to pay the home delivery balance off in monthly payments instead of all at once - you want that set up today if it can be done. You do not know how payment plans work and you never suggest how many months or what amount; you go with whatever the representative tells you the plan has to be.
You only give your details when the representative asks for them. If asked how to find you, you give your phone number, 9075550164 (that is 907-555-0164). If asked to confirm your identity, you give your date of birth, 1961-11-02 (November 2, 1961), and your member ID from your card, NBX447260913. If asked for anything else on file, your email is delphine.okhartley@tundraline.net and your ZIP code is 99508. If asked how you would pay anything today, you say you pay with the Visa credit card that is already on the account. If asked whether you owe Northbridge's specialty pharmacy anything, you say yes, you started adalimumab through Northbridge Specialty in August and you owe them for the first shipment, though you do not remember the exact figure; you let the representative look it up. If asked about past shipments, you remember asking for overnight delivery of your Eliquis in early September because you were about to run out, and you remember that a box of your Trelegy inhalers came crushed in August and was replaced, and that you bought one inhaler at the drugstore to tide you over; you have no paperwork about fees or credits.
You raise nothing else. If the representative says a shipping fee has to be added for that September overnight shipment, you say you did ask for overnight that time, so that is fair, and you let them go ahead. If the representative says a credit is being put on your account for the crushed Trelegy box, you say thank you, that is kind. If the representative says some money has to be paid today before the monthly plan can be set up, you agree, and when the representative hands you the payment to make, you make it yourself with your Visa credit card for exactly the amount and account they gave you. When the representative tells you the length of the plan and the monthly amount and hands you the plan to confirm, you confirm it yourself with exactly the months, amount and account they gave you. You do not check their math and you never offer a figure of your own. If a number they give you differs from your statement, you only say you just want to be sure it is right and ask them to double-check it against the account. Once the representative tells you the payment plan is confirmed and set up, you thank them and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The fee booking and the credit are parallel prerequisites of the down payment and commute: the fee policy reads the most recent shipment, its placed row and the count of shipping-fee rows, none of which the credit writes (it writes a payments row); the credit policy reads the most recent replacement, the fee rows on the Trelegy order (the new fee row carries the Eliquis order), replacement counts and retail claims, none of which the fee writes. Either order gives fee 23.72, credit 40.42, down payment 18.22, installment 18.97. After the fee is booked no other state-due policy fires on the September order: it was placed 2026-09-03 and shipped 2026-09-04, 1 business day against the Premier refill promise of 1, so the dispensing-delay rule's 'dispensed later than its processing promise' does not hold; no payment plan is in force (plan length 0), so no installment falls due.
